## What and why

## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added or updated (`pytest` passes)
- [ ] `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .` and `mypy` pass
- [ ] If a security guarantee or limitation changed: `docs/threat-model.md` updated
- [ ] If the protocol or file formats changed: `docs/protocol.md` updated and a new version identifier used where signed/hashed bytes change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under *Unreleased*
